name: Eight Keystones
slug: A set of eight stones corresponding to the eight Arch realms of Atlas, used with the arches that link those realms.
description: The Eight Keystones are a set of eight stones corresponding to the eight Arch realms of Atlas. They are used in connection with the arches linking these realms. Six keystones are currently assigned to party members: Gerk holds Midgard, Sylan holds Gilbrick, Dana holds Pitel, Walker holds The Reach, Ord holds Feldspar, and Ciri holds Lith. The La-rel and Turof keystones remain unassigned and are being held in stewardship.
